cards.t: Cysic Suspends Bridge After Unauthorized Token Mint
cards.b: Cysic suspended its crypto bridge after an unauthorized mint of 10 million CYS tokens, with about $727,000 bridged to Ethereum.

per.CYS: Hit by an unauthorized mint of 10 million tokens and bridge suspension.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Full recovery details and resumption date.

cards.t: CME Group Adds Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap Futures
cards.b: CME Group is expanding its single-asset crypto lineup to 11 by adding Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures.

per.BCH: CME Group is adding Bitcoin Cash futures.
per.UNI: CME Group is adding Uniswap futures.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: The exact launch date for the futures contracts.

cards.t: XRPL Lending Code Patch Prepared for Validators
cards.b: Validators have a bug-fix patch for the XRP Ledger lending code on course to go live Friday, though the underlying lending system is still short of approval votes.
